scope: Signed-in browser edit -> save -> reopen for one existing canvas artifact in the WA-045 scratch world. Artifact creation is proven separately by the 29/29 isolated-harness package; this package proves the exact save and reload read-back of the recorded artifact.

source.verified_by: backend /health identity reported git_commit=8bb0c66f5fd3, revision=8bb0c66f5fd30988c16585214707bf784fa39d41, identity_kind=git, dirty=false

environment.database: fresh scratch atom.db inside that world, created by the product startup path
environment.provider_keys: blanked for the backend process; no provider or model endpoint was contacted

exact_text:
WA-045 exact body line one: ORD-WA045-ALPHA
Exact body line two: 17 * 3 = 51
Trailing marker: WA045-END
exact_text_sha256_basis: sha256 over the UTF-8 bytes of exact_text; the run's canvas:update broadcast independently reports the same 103-character content length

save.path_taken: idle autosave after the edit (3 s debounce)
save.note: The panel had already autosaved, so a second explicit save wait timed out and no Save Changes control was rendered; the durable save recorded here is the autosave request.

checks.name: signed-in browser session opened a blank document canvas
exact three-line body was typed into the native editor
the edit reached the durable canvas save endpoint with HTTP 200
the save was bound to the prior content revision
the panel reported the edit saved before reload
the browser reloaded the same artifact URL
the editor value after reload is the exact saved text
the reloaded page read the artifact and its history back from the backend
no non-loopback request other than pinned Monaco editor static assets

external_origins.policy: loopback frontend/backend only, plus the pinned Monaco editor static-asset CDN; no provider, model, or workspace-data call is permitted or observed

cdn.purpose: static editor code, language contributions and workers loaded by @monaco-editor/react's default loader
cdn.request_bodies: none; every observed request is a static-asset GET

excluded: request headers and bodies other than the recorded exact canvas text
absolute filesystem paths and process ids
